title: Payment Methods and Automatic Payments by Plan Term
content:
Patient Services desk reference for **Patient Payment Plans**: the payment methods each plan term accepts, whether the term must be paid by automatic draw, when a failed draw is retried, and how payments that differ from the installment due are treated under the term's settings.

## Methods accepted

| Term | Automatic payment required | Methods for automatic draws | Methods for manual installments, cures and payoffs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | No | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH) | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH), check, HSA/FSA card |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | No | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH) | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH), check, HSA/FSA card |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | No | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH) | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH), check, HSA/FSA card |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | No | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH) | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH), check, HSA/FSA card |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | Yes | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH) | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH), check, HSA/FSA card |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | Yes | debit card, bank transfer (ACH) | credit card, debit card, bank transfer (ACH), check, HSA/FSA card |

"Automatic payment required" means the installments must be drawn automatically from a card or bank account on file. The 24-Month Extended Payment Plan does not take automatic draws from a credit card.

## Settings on payments

| Term | Failed automatic draw retried after (calendar days) | Payment below the installment due counts toward it | Payment above the installment reduces the balance, schedule unchanged | Returned or charged-back installment payment counts as missed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 3 | No | Yes | Yes |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 3 | No | Yes | Yes |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 3 | No | Yes | Yes |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 3 | No | Yes | Yes |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 3 | No | Yes | Yes |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 3 | No | Yes | Yes |

- **Retry**: a failed automatic draw is retried once, 3 calendar days after the failure, on every term.
- **Payment below the installment due**: the column records whether such a payment counts toward that installment; on no term does it.
- **Payment above the installment**: on every term, an extra-principal payment reduces the balance without changing the schedule.
- **Returned payment**: on every term, an installment whose payment is returned or charged back counts as missed.

## Points of reference

- A patient on the 9-Month Payment Plan may choose not to use automatic payments; a patient on the 18-Month Payment Plan may not.
- Paying a manual installment by check or with an HSA/FSA card is accepted on every term; neither method is accepted for automatic draws on any term.
